title: Signature Law-Book of No
description: Higgins' law-book collects every 'no' physics and logic have ever said — conservation, thermodynamics, undecidability — as one searchable book. A proposal is checked against the whole book before a dollar is spent; the book's 'no' is final.

demo.code:
import random
random.seed(1001)
power_w=100; hours=24.0; budget_kwh=50.0
need_kwh=power_w*hours/1000.0
margin=budget_kwh-need_kwh
feasible=margin>=0
print(f"need={need_kwh:.1f}kWh budget={budget_kwh:.1f}kWh margin={margin:.1f}kWh")
print(f"verdict={'FEASIBLE' if feasible else 'INFEASIBLE'} utilization={need_kwh/max(budget_kwh,1e-9)*100:.0f}%")
print("DEMO_OK")
demo.output:
need=2.4kWh budget=50.0kWh margin=47.6kWh
verdict=FEASIBLE utilization=5%
DEMO_OK
demo.note: Runnable demo program verified by execution during the database build.

architecture: Laws are indexed by the claims they forbid; proposals are matched against the index. A hit returns the law, the margin of violation, and the citation — the no is documented, not decreed.
